title: Variance identities and bounds
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its variance equals $1-(\mathbb{E}f)^2$, and also equals four times the product of the uniform probabilities that $f$ takes the values $+1$ and $-1$; moreover, $0\le \operatorname{Var}(f)\le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
